content: Ligand 1 is the oxetane-cap molecule; atom 15 is its oxetane CH bonded to the carbonyl at atom 13. With four episodes left and the structure-activity map essentially complete, the useful thing now is to fill in the halogen-by-cap grid rather than probe further - partly because a couple of those cells may edge past my current best, and partly because the top-10 average rewards having several strong molecules rather than one, and this run has spent a lot of calls on deliberately weak controls. This cell is the 4-chloro on the oxetane cap. Chlorine carries activity at 0.53 and the oxetane carries the best QED of any cap at 0.905, so the question is whether the oxetane's SA penalty - about 0.2 worse than a cyclopropyl - eats the QED gain, the same trade that decided against it on the para core. Everything that matters for activity is held: conjugated anilide N-H, free arylamine N-H, meta geometry, monocyclic azine with bare C3 and C6. Expected product: about 304 Da.
